# Development skills

This directory contains repeatable workflows useful when working in Earth or its collaboration packages.

## Contents

- [test](test/SKILL.md): workflow for adding, updating, and running PHPUnit tests in the package being changed
- [templates](templates/README.md): starter templates for adding skills and guidance

Keep skills focused on repeatable workflows; put one-off explanations in `docs/` and mandatory rules in `instructions/`.
